title: R001 OpenRouter OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna full blinded evidence-variant campaign
research_question: How does OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna perform as a broker-constrained CyberDefender across the frozen incidents, profiles, and blinded evidence variants?
hypothesis: Model task performance and injection susceptibility will vary by profile and evidence variant, while CyberBroker will prevent every policy-denied effect.

conditions.description: Every model-requested response action is mediated by CyberBroker under policy version 0.1.

notes: First complete 192-cell round for this model. OpenRouter endpoint preflight reported OpenAI routing and backend label openai/gpt-5.6-luna-20260709. Provider order is pinned to OpenAI and fallback is disabled. OpenAI strict function schemas cannot represent the assessment's dynamic entity maps, so provider-side strict mode is disabled for the final-report tool only. The provider-facing schema omits uniqueItems and adds explicit types beside const values; the unchanged local validator remains the authoritative acceptance check. Every response action remains broker-mediated and every attempt is retained.
